g.text: No PWR_FLAG, no ERC exclusions, no production footprint claims.

g.desc: No PWR_FLAG, no ERC exclusions, no production footprint claims.

g.text: SPDT COMMON2 to ON1: MASTER_EN high. To OFF3: DISCHARGE_EN high; MASTER_EN pulled low. Open=passive decay.

g.desc: SPDT COMMON2 to ON1: MASTER_EN high. To OFF3: DISCHARGE_EN high; MASTER_EN pulled low. Open=passive decay.

g.text: IN+BIAS=UPS_RAW; OUT=SYS_RAW. No MCU/I2C control. Charger and gauge remain upstream and powered.

g.desc: IN+BIAS=UPS_RAW; OUT=SYS_RAW. No MCU/I2C control. Charger and gauge remain upstream and powered.

g.text: Three separate150R+NMOS discharge branches need upstream bias;4.7k bleeders remain if all sources vanish.

g.desc: Three separate150R+NMOS discharge branches need upstream bias;4.7k bleeders remain if all sources vanish.

g.text: Overlap is resistor-limited, NOT assumed absent. Contact/ESD, hot leakage, resistor pulse and rail injection gates OPEN.

g.desc: Overlap is resistor-limited, NOT assumed absent. Contact/ESD, hot leakage, resistor pulse and rail injection gates OPEN.

g.text: CANDIDATE WIRED: mechanical SYSTEM HARD OFF, upstream of every system rail. Backfeed/leakage qualification OPEN.

g.desc: CANDIDATE WIRED: mechanical SYSTEM HARD OFF, upstream of every system rail. Backfeed/leakage qualification OPEN.
